# SPA.4 — SPA skeleton: router tree, auth gate, bffFetch, session, SsrHandoff, head manager (run ledger)

- **Status:** DONE (Stage A; offline-only ticket — no deploy, no live legs owed)
- **Harness:** Devin CLI (agentic coding subagent); model: Cognition Devin; tier: n/a (build work)
- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/101_SPA.4__spa-skeleton.md` (manifest row 101)
- **Branch:** `stevevitali/spa-4-skeleton`, stacked on `stevevitali/spa-3-shell-document` @
  `e61185a` (`OPERATOR` merge policy, **not merged**). PR **#122**.
- **Goal:** the client half of the shell — TanStack Router over a committed `routeTree.gen.ts`
  (file-based, autoCodeSplitting, every authenticated document route registered day one per
  REQ-NAV-1), a root `beforeLoad` auth gate, the one same-origin `bffFetch` transport, `GET
  /session` + `data-spa-boot` boot hydration, `SsrHandoff` for unflipped routes, and the client
  head manager (title/focus/route-announcement + settle markers).
- **Spend:** $0. No deploys, no production writes.

## 0 — Context load

- DEFERRALS.md read first (per AGENTS): no `OPEN` row is unblocked by SPA.4 — every open row is a
  live-deploy leg, a HUMAN prerequisite, a funded-window spend leg, or a product decision; none
  is SPA-scoped or gated on the client skeleton. No new row owed: every SPA.4 AC is
  deterministic-engineered — the happy-dom suite mounts the real router against a synthetic boot
  map and observes document navigations through the `spaRuntime.assign` seam; the only leg that
  could not run in-repo (a real-browser keyboard/screen-reader pass over focus + live-region)

  stamping) standing in as the compensating control — the surface tickets' journey legs re-verify
  the same markers on deployed code (REQ-SPEC-29).
- LEDGER CURRENT STATE read: `nextTicket: SPA.4`, `chainTip:
  stevevitali/spa-3-shell-document` (`e61185a`), `mergePolicy: OPERATOR`.
- Design sources applied, not re-derived: `docs/frontend-spa-spec.md` §3.2 (boot embed = seed,
  not grant), §3.3 (`{error, detail?}` envelope + `x-rhema-request-id`), §3.4 (settle/markers),
  §7 (auth boundary); `docs/design/20` (bffFetch contract — one transport, same-origin,
  no-retry POSTs, QueryClient per boot, `ensureQueryData` loaders, intent preload); `docs/design/25`
  (SsrHandoff strangler exit, fuzzy not-found, search grammar forward-compat); `docs/design/26`

## 1 — What landed

- **`apps/web/src/spa/main.tsx`** — `createSpaRouter({boot?, queryClient?, history?})` (the test
  seam: injectable boot/history so happy-dom mounts the real router) + `mountSpa(root)` under
  `StrictMode` (REQ-ED-1's double-mount discipline — every effect idempotent). Module-init mounts
  onto `[data-spa-root]` iff present. Router options per contract and pinned by test:
  `defaultPreload:"intent"`, `defaultPreloadStaleTime:0`, `scrollRestoration:true`,
  `notFoundMode:"fuzzy"`, `defaultPendingComponent:PendingShell`,
  `defaultNotFoundComponent:SpaNotFound`, `defaultErrorComponent:SpaRouteError`. The boot
  principal seeds `["session"]` via `setQueryData` (seed-not-grant — `/session` stays the
  oracle). `setSessionExpiredHandler` binds the 401 leg: `setQueryData(undefined)` +
  `invalidateQueries({refetchType:"none"})` + `navigateDocument("/login")` — deliberately NOT
  `removeQueries`: destroying the in-flight session query cancels the pending
  `ensureQueryData`, which surfaces a `CancelledError` and swallows the `BffError` the gate
  keys on (caught by test).
- **`apps/web/src/spa/routeTree.gen.ts`** — regenerated by the router plugin during
  `vite build`; committed; **regeneration is byte-stable** (`vite build` → `diff` clean).
- **`apps/web/src/spa/routes/`** — `__root.tsx` (the `HeadManager` + `Outlet`), `_authenticated.tsx`
  (the ONE `beforeLoad` auth gate: `ensureQueryData(sessionQuery)`; `BffError 401` ⇒
  `throw redirect({href:"/login", reloadDocument:true})` — a document navigation since `/login`
  is outside the tree; non-401 propagates to the error boundary — a designed error, never a
  forged sign-out), and **43 leaf/layout files** covering every `SPA_DOCUMENT_ROUTES` routeId —
  asserted exhaustively at runtime (`router.routesByPath` ⊇ the contract enumeration,
  `spa.dom.test.tsx`). Layouts (`p.$project`, `app.settings`, `settings`, `usage`) own `Outlet`s;
  `p.$project`'s loader runs `ensureQueryData(feedLabelsQuery)` — the loader pattern the surface
  tickets extend. Leaves are `surfaceComponent("<routeId>")` stubs — a literal `component:`
  property per file so autoCodeSplitting hoists each into its own lazy chunk (~0.1 kB each per
  `check:spa-budget`; entry chunk 529 kB within ceilings).
- **`apps/web/src/spa/bff.ts`** — `bffFetch<T>`: the ONE transport. Same-origin `/…` paths only
  (`"//…"` and absolute URLs rejected up front — the session cookie can never ride a cross-origin
  request, REQ-DAT-7); `credentials:"same-origin"`, `accept: application/json`, `init.json` ⇒
  JSON body + `content-type`. Non-2xx ⇒ `BffError{status, code, detail?, requestId}` — the
  server's `{error, detail?}` envelope + `x-rhema-request-id` preserved verbatim (malformed
  bodies ⇒ `request_failed`). 401 ⇒ `onSessionExpired()` (bound at mount: invalidate
  `["session"]` + `/login` document nav) then `BffError(401,"unauthenticated")`. Exactly one
  `fetch` per call — no client-side retry ever (REQ-BFF-30; GET retry policy lives in the
  QueryClient).
- **`apps/web/src/spa/queries.ts`** — `makeSpaQueryClient()` per boot (REQ-BFF-10 — nothing
  sensitive survives a session): `BffError` ⇒ never retry (an HTTP answer is definitive);
  transport drops retry ≤2; mutations `retry:false`. `sessionQuery` (`["session"]` → `GET
  /session` — REQ-BFF-18's pinned path, **not** `/bff/session`; `staleTime:30s`) and
  `feedLabelsQuery` (`["feed-labels"]` → `GET /bff/feed-labels`; `staleTime:Infinity` —
  deploy-versioned server copy).
- **`apps/web/src/server.ts`** — `GET /bff/feed-labels`: session-gated (401 anonymous), answers
  the same `feedLabelMaps()` object SSR embeds as `data-feed-labels` (REQ-BFF-24).
- **`apps/web/src/data.ts`** — `checkSession` promoted from raw `fetch` to the typed api-client
  `getSession()` (REQ-DAT-13 leg): any non-2xx ⇒ `false`; the session-gate boolean contract is
  unchanged.
- **`apps/web/src/doc-meta.ts`** + **`render.tsx`** — `docMetaFor`/`SITE` moved verbatim into a
  browser-safe leaf (the client can't reach the server renderer graph); `render.tsx` re-exports
  so `spa-shell.ts`/`server.ts` imports are untouched. SSR titles and the client head manager now
  share the one function (REQ-BND-8).
- **`apps/web/src/spa-boot.ts`** — the `SpaBoot` wire contract shared by the shell's producer and
  the client decoder (type-only imports — compiles under both `tsconfig.json` and
  `tsconfig.spa.json`); `spa-shell.ts` now imports it.
- **`apps/web/src/spa/boot.ts`** — `readSpaBoot()` decodes `script[data-spa-boot]` fail-closed
  (absent/malformed ⇒ `null` ⇒ every leaf SsrHandoffs — the flag set shrinks, never grows);
  the document-level `getSpaBoot`/`setSpaBoot` singleton (the not-found boundary's `SsrHandoff`
  sits outside router providers); `isSpaEnabled(boot, routeId)` ⇔
  `boot.surfaces[routeId]==="spa"`.
- **`apps/web/src/spa/head.tsx`** — `HeadManager`: per committed navigation (keyed on location
  key) it stamps `data-route` = `spaRouteFor(pathname).routeId` (the same matcher SSR uses — the
  markers agree across renderers) → `document.title` via `docMetaFor` → polite `role="status"`
  live-region echo → once `isLoading` is false, `data-mounted` (REQ-VFY-3) + focus to the `#hash`
  target else the mount's `<h1>` (`tabIndex=-1` if needed — REQ-UX-7/9, REQ-NAV-7).
- **`apps/web/src/spa/states.tsx`** — `SsrHandoff` (document-nav to the current href — the
  strangler exit; paints a skeleton while resolving, never blank), `SurfaceBoundary`/`SurfaceShell`/
  `surfaceComponent` (the leaf stub pattern), `PendingShell`, `SpaRouteError` (`COPY.spaError`
  — a designed state with a reload affordance, distinct from the auth redirect),
  `SpaNotFound` (`surfaces===null` paths — the five server-owned redirect-only GETs — hand back
  to the server so its canonical 302 answers; the rest of SPA-space not-found is client-owned,
  REQ-NAV-10).
- **`apps/web/src/spa/search.ts`** — `validateSearchParams(known)`/`strParam`/`oneParam`:
  forward-compatible `validateSearch` grammar (unknown keys pass; pinned keys narrow against
  closed sets; a bogus pinned value drops the key — REQ-NAV-3). Not yet consumed by any leaf —
  the surface tickets adopt it per-route.
- **`apps/web/src/spa/dom.ts`** — `navigateDocument`/`spaRuntime.assign` — the one seam every
  document navigation flows through (test-observable without stubbing `window.location`).
- **`apps/web/src/copy.ts`** — `COPY.spaError` (the route-error strings; REQ-UX-12 — every
  user-facing string is a COPY leaf; `@rhema/ui` components stay text-agnostic).
- **`apps/web/src/spa/routes/index.tsx` deleted** — SPA.1's smoke scaffold is superseded by the
  real tree (the smoke test's mount-only contract is now exercised by `spa.dom.test.tsx`).

- `apps/web/src/spa/boot.test.ts` (8) — embed parse (principal/theme/device/surfaces/project);

- `apps/web/src/spa/bff.test.ts` (6) — same-origin guard (`//evil`/`https://` rejected before any
  fetch); typed JSON success; `{error,detail}` + `x-rhema-request-id` preserved with upstream
  status; malformed error body ⇒ `request_failed`; 401 ⇒ handler fires + `BffError(401)`; a POST
  issues exactly one fetch even on failure (REQ-BFF-30).
- `apps/web/src/spa/spa.dom.test.tsx` (19, happy-dom) — the router itself: mounts under
  `[data-spa-root]`; a flipped route renders + stamps `data-route`/`data-mounted` after resolve;
  an unflipped leaf ⇒ `SsrHandoff` document-navigates to the SAME href (the strangler's ≤1
  boundary cross, observed through `spaRuntime.assign`); `surfaces===null` not-found ⇒ document
  nav (server-owned 302 preserved); in-SPA-space unknown path ⇒ `COPY.notFound`; 401 session ⇒
  `["session"]` invalidated + `/login` document nav (both the `bffFetch` leg and the
  `beforeLoad` redirect); non-401 loader failure ⇒ the designed error component, **not** `/login`
  and not blank; pending ⇒ skeleton rows (never blank); head manager — title parity with
  `docMetaFor`, h1 focus on nav, `#hash` target focus wins, live-region echoes the title and a
  same-title nav still re-announces; router options pin (intent/scrollRestoration/fuzzy);
  `routesByPath` covers every contract routeId.
- `apps/web/src/spa/tree.test.ts` (3) — `routeTree.gen.ts` committed + regenerated + names every
  route file the contract implies; **no route file eagerly imports the server/SSR graph**
  (`render`, `data`, `page-data`, `server`, `spa-shell`, `feed-labels`, `device`,
  `observability`, `state-map` banned by regex) and none contains a `dynamic import()`
  (REQ-TL-9 — lazy leaves carry zero surface code; the split is structural).
- `apps/web/src/spa-shell.test.ts` (+2 → 31) — `GET /bff/feed-labels`: 401 anonymous; the
  verbatim `feedLabelMaps()` payload with a session; `GET /session` contract re-pinned against
  the promoted `checkSession` seam.

## 4 — Findings / deviations / CI

- **Size budget exceeded (owned decision, recorded):** ~1.9k changed lines excl. generated vs the
  ticket's ~600 guide. Structural, not scope creep: REQ-NAV-1's day-one registration forces 43
  route files (~500 lines of unavoidable `createFileRoute` stubs) and the
  every-behavior-a-failing-test clause adds ~600 test lines. Alternatives considered — a
  codegen'd leaf directory (rejected: adds build machinery for zero behavior), collapsing leaves
  into a loop over the contract table (rejected: file-based routing + per-leaf autoCodeSplitting
  IS the REQ-TL-9 mechanism; a runtime loop welds every leaf into one chunk). The budget is a
  sizing guide; recorded honestly rather than gamed.
- **Owned decision — `docMetaFor` moved, not duplicated** (title parity REQ-BND-8): extracting
  the function into `doc-meta.ts` (browser-safe) beats a forked title table that would drift;
  `render.tsx` re-exports so the import graph is additive-only.
- **Owned decision — `checkSession` promotion** (REQ-DAT-13): the typed `getSession()` seam
  replaces the raw fetch; the consumer's contract is boolean so error kinds are collapsed to
  `false` — the honest behavior the session gate already had.
- **Owned decision — 401 leg uses invalidate, not remove:** `removeQueries` cancels the in-flight
  `ensureQueryData`, converting the auth signal into a `CancelledError` the gate can't
  distinguish from navigation abortion; `setQueryData(undefined)` + `invalidateQueries(
  {refetchType:"none"})` drops the cached principal while letting the gate observe the real
  `BffError(401)`. Pinned by the dom suite.
- **Owned decision — intent prefetch is router-level only:** `defaultPreload:"intent"` is the
  design/20 mechanism; the skeleton has no nav `<Link>`s (chrome arrives SPA.9). The option is
  pinned by test; recording so REQ-UX-2's hover-warm legs are honestly attributed.
- **Owned decision — `spaRuntime.assign` indirection:** happy-dom forbids replacing
  `window.location`; the one-object seam makes every document navigation observable without
  weakening the production path (it IS `window.location.assign`).
- **Owned decision — `fileURLToPath` in tree.test.ts:** the checkout path contains a non-ASCII
  character (`Rhēma`); raw `URL.pathname` keeps `%C4%93` and `fs` calls ENOENT — the failure the
  first full-suite run caught. Decode before fs.
- **Deferrals:** none opened, none closed.
- **REQ ids stamped:** REQ-FW-1..11; REQ-NAV-1..5, 7, 9..11; REQ-BND-6..10; REQ-DAT-7, 13
  (checkSession leg); REQ-VFY-3; REQ-UX-1, 2, 6, 7, 9, 11, 12; REQ-TL-9; REQ-INV-2 (auth-gate
  leg).
- **Out of scope held:** no surface components/loaders beyond the `feedLabelsQuery` warm (surface
  tickets own leaves); no mutation envelope (SPA.5); no editor/collab (SPA.23/24); no flag set
  anywhere; the SSR fallback untouched; `?ssr=1` still serves SSR byte-for-byte.
